instruction: Look at bracket.dxf, shaft.dxf, spacer.dxf, and cap.dxf. On this machine, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `bracket.dxf`. Create one simplified non-overlapping 2D mount assembly layout from the already opened files, showing only the listed visible profile geometry rather than a hidden-line side view. Draw a bracket rectangle with opposite corners at (0,0) and (120,80), a shaft circle centered at (160,40) with radius 18, a spacer outer circle centered at (210,40) with radius 26 and inner radius 18, and a cap rectangle with opposite corners at (245,20) and (295,60). Add bracket through-hole circles at (20,20) and (100,20) with radius 5, and add text ACAD-18 on layer ANNOTATION. Use OUTLINE for the bracket rectangle, shaft circle, spacer outer circle, and cap rectangle; use CUTOUT for the spacer inner circle; use HOLE for bracket holes. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
